items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: We used to go around with Christian, you know what I'm saying? Christian the fiddle player, his daddy.

ctx.x: Fake musician. No, there wasn't any legitimate sound like the Robichoke band. No, no, no. Nothing like that.

He had this town tied up one time, Jack Lane. Man, everything was the Reliance band and from there on that was it. I remember when I was a young fellow, before I started to play music, he used to play, you fool around with the guitars and stuff like that. We used to go around with Christian, you know what I'm saying? Christian the fiddle player, his daddy. He was a good trumpet man too, this fiddle player.
